vectors.description: list_rulesets gives each rule set's name, size, configuration and outputs, sorted by name
an empty catalog lists no rule sets
summary gives the rule set's summary and its input schema
evaluate gives the selected rule, the winner's payload as output, and the outputs
rules whose condition is unknown, because a field is missing, are listed in unknown
under rule_order there is no output, only the outputs of every selected rule
with an aggregate, output is the aggregate's map
an aggregate with nothing selected is null
a single-hit policy with nothing selected has a null output
a decimal is sent in the format's encoding, and compares exactly
explain adds the explanation's text, whole when it fits the default budget

explanation.text:
HIT POLICY priority: selected loyal
[ ] vip (not fired): customer.years > 5 AND since IS NULL
    - customer.years > 5 is false (customer.years = 3); short by 2
[x] loyal (selected): customer.years > 2
    - customer.years > 2 is true (customer.years = 3)
[x] base (fired, not selected): TRUE
    fired, but loyal has a higher priority (5 > 0)
    - TRUE is true

vectors.description: a rule set document given as an object reads, with its summary and input schema
a rule given as text reads as a rule, which gives a rule set of that one rule

arguments.document: RULE adult IF age >= 18 THEN ok = TRUE

vectors.description: a JSON document may be given as a string with the format json
an object document may name its format, json
a condition reads, but gives no rule set, so it has no summary
a decision table given as CSV reads, and gives the rule set it compiles to
a document that does not read is a result with the reader's error, located in the document
a construction rule broken in the document is its expression_error, with the pointer into the document
a text that does not parse gives its line and column

arguments.document:
RULE adult
IF age >=
THEN ok = TRUE

vectors.description: a document of another version is unsupported_version
a decision is read with its rule set, so validating one is unsupported
a summary is output only, so validating one is unsupported
